issues: 目标是灰阶占位 dashboard 里一张静止的空白卡，「运动中捕获」完全没有体现
全画面浅灰底 + 灰条，没有配色和光，像线框稿
标签只有一行小字胶囊，咬合后没有任何信息兑现
飞入后角标只是收缩贴卡，画面其余部分静止，锁定后没有后续
changes: look = sand：为镜头设计的暖沙纸质城市地图（圆角街区随机分地块、斜穿主干道、河与公园，路名只当纹理），强调色赤陶只给取景框、被锁定骑手与路线
目标改为一位正在行驶的配送骑手（同城配送「Juniper」）：地图相机缓移、其他骑手照常行驶，取景框飞入时要追着打中，咬合后逐帧跟随——真正的运动中捕获
角标改为 6px 圆头赤陶笔画 + 奶白衬底；飞入 12f out-cubic 行程 1150×640 带速度斜向模糊；收缩 2.5×→0.9×→1 与飞入重叠 6f；咬合帧角标收紧 8px 弹回 + 光环扩散 + 周围暖色柔光压淡
锁定后兑现信息：标签卡（32px 人名 + 64px「3 min away」+ LOCKED）带引线弹簧弹出，送达路线从骑手沿街画向终点、地址图钉弹出，相机 smooth 推近 7%
时长 90f → 120f：0–14 预备（地图已在动）→ 14–46 飞入收缩咬合 → 48–76 标签 / 路线 / 图钉 → 76–120 跟随 hold，尾帧是完整的地图海报
issuesEn: The target was a static blank card in a grey placeholder dashboard, so 'capture in motion' never showed
A light grey frame of grey bars with no colour or light, reading like a wireframe
The label was a single small pill of text; nothing paid off after the lock
After flying in, the corners just shrank onto the card while the rest of the frame stood still, with nothing after the lock
changesEn: Look = sand: a shot-designed warm paper city map (rounded blocks split into lots, a diagonal avenue, a river and parks, street names as texture); terracotta accent only on the reticle, the locked courier and the route

The target is now a courier riding through the map (fictional delivery app Juniper): the camera drifts and other couriers keep moving, so the reticle has to catch a moving target and keeps tracking it after the lock — real capture in motion

Corners are 6px round-capped terracotta strokes on a cream underlay; a 12f out-cubic fly-in over 1150×640 with diagonal velocity blur; shrink 2.5×→0.9×→1 overlapping the flight by 6f; on lock the corners bite in 8px and spring back, a ring pulses out and a warm wash softens the surroundings

The lock pays off: a label card (32px name, 64px '3 min away', LOCKED) springs out on a leader line, the delivery route draws along the streets to the destination, an address pin pops in, and the camera pushes in 7%
Duration 90f → 120f: 0–14 anticipation (the map is already moving) → 14–46 fly-in, shrink, lock → 48–76 card, route, pin → 76–120 tracking hold, ending on a complete map poster
